# Damac Bay I

> DAMAC Bay by Cavalli is a three-tower residential complex at Dubai Harbour, the marina and cruise district between Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters Island. Each tower rises 55 storeys to about 200 metres above a shared podium, and the development holds roughly 1,066 apartments and upper-floor duplexes, some with private pools. Interiors and amenities are branded by Roberto Cavalli, and residents have beach access, pools and leisure decks.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Harbour, UAE
- Status: On-Going

## MENASCO Scope

DAMAC Bay by Cavalli is a luxury waterfront residential development by DAMAC Properties in Dubai Harbour, comprising three towers with around 1,066 apartments and upper-floor duplexes, some with private pools. MENASCO is responsible for the complete MEP works, covering the engineering, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting systems, including marine-grade solutions suited to the coastal setting.
